(x+z-y)(x-z+y) = x^2 - (y-z)^2 = L*yz for some constant L. Substituting x = k-y-z gives k^2 - 2k(y+z) + 2yz = (L-2)yz, i.e. k(k - 2(y+z)) = (L-4)yz. Since k-2(y+z) = -(k-2x) = -(y+z-x), we get (y+z-x) = ((4-L)/k)*yz, i.e. proportional to yz.
